sources.title: Growing Neural Cellular Automata
sources.authors: Alexander Mordvintsev; Ettore Randazzo; Eyvind Niklasson; Michael Levin
sources.version: Distill article published 11 February 2020, retrieved article text
sources.reading_depth: Actual selected Cell State, Cellular Automaton Rule, stochastic update, training and Experiments 2 and 3, plus reuse notice; not complete article or every notebook.
sources.license: Article diagrams/text CC BY 4.0 except separately attributed reused figures. Exact code/notebook licence was not inspected; no code copied or executed.
sources.official_code: The article exposes Colab reproduction notebooks and a source-GitHub link; exact repository/licence not independently inspected in this bounded task.
sources.primary_content_paraphrase: A shared local residual update rule and random asynchronous firing can grow and preserve a specified pattern. Pool training and damage-in-training improve recovery from erased regions. The target is an attractor; growth and regeneration are explicit earlier objectives.
sources.implication: 局部规则、受损训练、反复恢复和随机更新已有直接先例；随机异步更新本身不能被解释成经过校准的材料条件后验。

rejected_identity_lead.cause: A recalled identifier was tried before verification; it resolved to an unrelated astrophysics paper, Spatially Resolved Star Formation History Along the Disk of M82 Using Multi-Band Photometric Data.

independent_mathematical_screening.status: Analytic identities and assumptions, not a new algorithm or numerical/material test
independent_mathematical_screening.graph_energy: For fixed symmetric nonnegative weights W, L=D-W, and fixed observed values x_O, E(x)=0.5*x^T L*x has stationary missing block L_UU*x_U=-L_UO*x_O. If each unknown component is connected to an anchored node, L_UU is positive definite and the solution is unique.
independent_mathematical_screening.gaussian_relation: The conditioned Gaussian field with energy beta*E has mean -L_UU^{-1}L_UO*x_O and covariance (beta*L_UU)^{-1}. Deterministic local relaxation returns its mean/mode only. Without anchored connectivity or a proper reference term, singular precision must not be silently treated as a probability distribution.
independent_mathematical_screening.full_reference_caution: A low-dimensional deterministic repair that omits the retained full response residual changes the current paper's probability model and can collapse uncertainty. Calling the same linear solve a wound-healing solver does not show a new predictive law.
independent_mathematical_screening.nonlinear_updates: State-dependent or learned edge conductance may change the model. To call its endpoint a posterior or generator, specify a compatible joint law, a normalisable energy or an explicit distributional objective and a valid sampling rule. Stable convergence alone certifies neither a target distribution nor uncertainty calibration.
independent_mathematical_screening.update_order: Finite asynchronous rollout can depend on update schedule, initial hidden state and assimilation order. Compare A-then-B, B-then-A and union conditioning as a necessary diagnostic. A converged mean agreement is not sufficient to certify one coherent joint distribution; finite-MCMC path effects must be separated from a genuinely incompatible model.

fit_to_current_hydrogel_problem: Prioritise physical log-shear-rate coordinates, not arbitrary table-column adjacency. Distinct properties in a sparse wide table do not form a tissue lattice merely because columns are adjacent.
Image wounds often have surrounding boundary information. One-sided curve continuation has no observed high-rate boundary; local propagation cannot by itself reveal an unobserved rheological branch.

A single-attractor repair rule may regenerate a familiar profile while losing sample-specific alternatives. Multi-modal continuation must retain plausible branches rather than heal everything toward one prototype.
The original 25 complete formulations remain the information units; extra coordinates, masks, damage locations and rollout steps do not become independent materials.

An approximately 8000-parameter local NCA rule is not automatically a low-capacity alternative to the current five-parameter correction. Count all perception, hidden-state and update-rule parameters, and compare matched information and computational budgets.

No empirical claim is made that NCA cannot work at this sample size. Its extra flexibility, cost and uncertainty behaviour have to be measured under grouped evaluation, not dismissed from parameter count alone.

Domain usefulness can count as innovation without all-new theory; a credible new materials difficulty and matched evidence are required. No exact-match exclusion across all hydrogel literature is claimed.

recommended_bounded_next_step.priority: Mechanism falsification before a new large neural model
recommended_bounded_next_step.null_control: On a fully specified synthetic quadratic field, compare a local repair iteration with direct conditioned-Gaussian linear algebra. If they agree, report solver equivalence rather than a new completion model.
recommended_bounded_next_step.failure_control: Use two analytically specified curves that agree at low-rate anchors but differ at higher rates. A repair method should preserve ambiguity; a visually smooth endpoint is not evidence of recovery.
recommended_bounded_next_step.candidate_material_increment: Investigate whether local residual or relationship inconsistency can identify a concrete high-shear branch ambiguity and a genuinely informative extra measurement, beyond anchor-distance and GP uncertainty criteria. This is a hypothesis, not an established result from these papers.
strong_controls: Frozen current curvature Gaussian, coordinate GP and conditional Gaussian
Harmonic/linear local repair with the same boundary information
FPCA or another standard functional model if representation learning is proposed
Ordinary message-passing or IGRM-family control if learning a relation graph is proposed
Highest-allowed-rate, fixed/random and GP target-information selection if an extra measurement is proposed
must_measure: One-sided continuation separately from interior missing intervals
Observed-anchor preservation and dependence on physical coordinate spacing
CRPS / point error, interval score, coverage and sharpness separately
Joint/conditional consistency and retention of the full residual or plausible branches
Initialisation, update order, horizon and random seed sensitivity
Full parameter counts, material grouping and all failures
stops: Only the equilibrium of an unchanged Gaussian is recovered and no declared computational gain exists
Repair shrinks intervals or erases branches without better proper scores
Simple GP or a standard fixed-boundary solver performs as well under the same information budget
The benefit requires target-informed graph construction, window selection or repaired values reused as measured truth
The method only fills interior gaps and cannot address the declared one-sided continuation use
recommended_bounded_next_step.evidence_boundary: Synthetic checks and the already-consumed 25P/46 external curves cannot establish new independent material confirmation. Current MLST manuscript and all frozen science remain unchanged.

parent_summary: 可以借鉴局部感知、保持已知边界、反复恢复和主动探测；但固定图松弛、NCA再生、任意图消息传递、迭代关系重建及NCA扩散inpainting均已有直接先例。最值得证明的是这些机制在水凝胶单侧续接中是否处理了现有强GP遗漏的观测歧义，而不是让相同预测多迭代几步。
